screenshots.description: Mobile viewport (375x667). At the top (y=0, height=64, width=375), header has an intense crimson background (backgroundColor=rgb(225, 29, 72)) with logo 'KIVULI' at x=20, y=16.5 (Courier New, 24px) and 3 nav links 'WANAUME', 'WANAWAKE', 'MPYA' at x=122.27, y=19.5 with height=15. Language toggle button is missing. Hero section below header (y=64 to y=486) on background rgb(11, 11, 12) displays h1 'STREETWEAR YA USIKU WA DAR' (x=20, y=120, width=335, height=132) in uppercase red Courier New, followed by uppercase red body copy, and CTA 'NUNUA SASA' (x=20, y=347, width=152.23, height=49). Product section (#shop) stacks 6 cards vertically in 1 column (x=20, width=335, height=451 each), each with red borders, identical tee.svg placeholder (width=307, height=307), red h3 title, red Courier New price, and red 'ADD TO CART' button (x=34, width=156.08, height=49). Footer at bottom (y=3324, width=375, height=76) has solid red background (backgroundColor=rgb(225, 29, 72)) and Courier New uppercase text.

Tablet viewport (768x1024). Header spans full width 768px (height=64) with red background (backgroundColor=rgb(225, 29, 72)); logo at x=20, nav links aligned to right at x=515.27, y=19.5, with no language toggle. Hero section has h1 at x=20, y=120, width=728, height=44 in red Courier New, body copy in uppercase red, and CTA button 'NUNUA SASA' at x=20, y=238, width=152.23, height=49. Product grid (#shop) at y=377 arranges 6 cards into a 3-column by 2-row grid (card width=229.33, height=345.33); row 1 at y=377 (cards 1–3 at x=20, x=269.33, x=518.66) and row 2 at y=742.33 (cards 4–6 at x=20, x=269.33, x=518.66). All 6 cards show identical tee.svg (width=201.33, height=201.33), red h3, red Courier New price, and red button. Footer at y=1119.66 (height=62, width=768) has solid red background.

Desktop viewport (1280x800). Header spans width 1280px (height=64) with solid red background (backgroundColor=rgb(225, 29, 72)); logo at x=20, nav links at x=1027.27, y=19.5, language toggle missing. Hero section displays h1 at x=20, y=120, width=1240, height=44 in red Courier New uppercase, red uppercase body text, and CTA 'NUNUA SASA' at x=20, y=238, width=152.23, height=49. Product grid (#shop) at y=377 renders 5 cards across row 1 (cards 1–5 at x=20, x=272, x=524, x=776, x=1028; y=377; width=232, height=348 each) and card 6 isolated on row 2 at x=20, y=745, width=232. All cards display identical tee.svg (width=204, height=204), red h3, red Courier New price, and red button. Footer at y=1125 (height=62, width=1280) has solid red background.

defects.title: Accent color #E11D48 applied to header background, footer background, headings, prices, and borders
evidence: S-001 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 color=rgb(225, 29, 72)
defects.expected: Accent #E11D48 is reserved strictly for primary CTA buttons only — never for body text, headings, borders, header or footer backgrounds (A1). Background must be #0B0B0C, surface #141416, and text #F5F5F5 for a calm, premium night-time feel.
defects.actual: Both header and footer have solid crimson red backgrounds (backgroundColor=rgb(225, 29, 72)). Hero h1, card titles (h3), product prices, card borders, and section dividers are all rendered in rgb(225, 29, 72), drowning the storefront in loud red.

defects.title: Courier New monospace font used across branding, navigation, headings, prices, and footer
evidence: S-001 dom: body > header > div fontFamily=Courier New
S-001 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(1) fontFamily=Courier New
S-001 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 fontFamily=Courier New
S-001 dom: #shop > article:nth-of-type(1) > p fontFamily=Courier New
S-001 dom: body > footer fontFamily=Courier New
S-002 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 fontFamily=Courier New
S-003 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 fontFamily=Courier New
defects.expected: Typography must be Inter or system sans-serif ONLY. Monospace fonts are explicitly prohibited (A1: 'tech-startup look, not fashion').
defects.actual: Logo, navigation links, hero heading h1, card prices, and footer are rendered with fontFamily=Courier New.

defects.title: Headings, body copy, and card titles forced to all-caps
evidence: S-001 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 textTransform=uppercase
S-002 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 textTransform=uppercase
S-003 dom: body > main > section:nth-of-type(1) > h1 textTransform=uppercase
defects.expected: Sentence case for headings and body; UPPERCASE is allowed only for nav labels and small labels ≤14px (A1).
defects.actual: Hero h1, hero paragraph text, and card h3 headings all have textTransform=uppercase, creating an aggressive shouting appearance.

defects.title: SW/EN language toggle (button#lang-toggle) is missing from header
defects.expected: Header must include a SW/EN language toggle on the right (button#lang-toggle), visible across 375, 768, and 1280 viewports (A2).
defects.actual: check:M1-S1-a failed (0 matches for button#lang-toggle). The header contains only nav links 'WANAUME', 'WANAWAKE', and 'MPYA'.

defects.title: Product grid repeats single placeholder image tee.svg across all 6 cards
defects.expected: Each of the 6 product cards must have its OWN distinct product photo (sample photos permitted at M1, but never one placeholder repeated) (A3).
defects.actual: The exact same grey t-shirt graphic (tee.svg) is repeated across all 6 cards, including hoodie, cargo pants, cap, and jacket.

defects.title: Desktop product grid displays 5 columns instead of locked 4 columns
defects.expected: Grid column structure must be: 1 col at 375, 2–3 at 768, and 4 at 1280 (A3).
defects.actual: At 1280px desktop viewport, 5 cards sit in the first row at y=377 (cards 1 to 5), leaving card 6 isolated on the second row at y=745.

defects.title: Red text fails WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast on surface background
evidence: S-001 dom: #shop > article:nth-of-type(1) > p contrastRatio=3.92 LOW-CONTRAST
S-001 dom: #shop > article:nth-of-type(1) > h3 contrastRatio=3.92 LOW-CONTRAST
S-001 dom: body > header contrastRatio=4.31 LOW-CONTRAST
defects.expected: WCAG AA contrast (minimum 4.5:1 for body and standard text against background) (A1).
defects.actual: check:M1-S1-b failed with 13 text elements below 4.5:1 (contrast ratio 3.92:1 for red text on #141416 surface).

defects.title: Header navigation links touch targets are under 44px minimum height
evidence: S-001 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(1) height=15
S-001 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(2) height=15
S-001 dom: body > header > nav > a:nth-of-type(3) height=15
defects.expected: Touch targets for interactive navigation elements must be ≥ 44×44 px.
defects.actual: Nav link anchors have a rendered height of only 15px (touch 68.06x15, 77.78x15, 38.89x15 TOO-SMALL).

proposals.title: Refine card imagery and metadata styling for dark streetwear aesthetic
proposals.detail: Use distinct photography framed in consistent 1:1 or 4:5 fashion aspect ratios on dark surface tiles (#141416) with subtle 1px border (#27272A or #1F1F23), rendering product names in #F5F5F5 sentence case and prices in #A1A1AA or #E4E4E7.
proposals.rationale: High-end urban streetwear brands (e.g. Daily Paper, Fear of God) establish credibility through restrained, moody product tiles rather than loud red frames and monospaced red prices.

proposals.title: Add atmospheric vertical padding and secondary tag to Hero
proposals.detail: Increase hero top/bottom padding to 64px–96px on desktop, add a subtle night-vibe sub-header pill or kicker (e.g. 'DAR ES SALAAM · NIGHTWEAR'), and style the lead paragraph in 18px Inter (#A1A1AA) with generous line height.
proposals.rationale: Gives the hero editorial breathing room and establishes Dar es Salaam night streetwear identity without overwhelming the page.

proposals.title: Align card action buttons with flex auto-margin
proposals.detail: Apply `display: flex; flex-direction: column;` to `.card` with `margin-top: auto` on the CTA button container so all buttons sit pinned to the bottom of the card regardless of name length.
proposals.rationale: Maintains crisp visual baseline alignment across cards in both Swahili and English.

findings.notes: The build diverges fundamentally from the locked brand system in A1: instead of a dark, calm, premium night-time palette (#0B0B0C / #141416 / #F5F5F5) with restrained accent #E11D48 on primary CTAs only, the entire header and footer are bright crimson red, and all headings, prices, borders, and body text are rendered in red Courier New monospace. The language toggle is missing (A2), all 6 cards repeat the same tee.svg (A3), and desktop grid displays 5 columns instead of 4 (A3). These require an immediate comprehensive change order for Round 1.
